name: W Punta Cana
positioning: An all-inclusive W resort on Punta Cana's Uvero Alto coast, with an infinity pool along the shore, oversized rooms with balconies and suites with private swimming pools
best_for: Couples and friends who want an all-inclusive beach stay with a design-led, social energy
Travelers who want a suite with a private pool for real swimming

facts.text: Every room has a rainfall shower and a deep soaking bathtub.
Every room has a king-size bed, even doubles.
The Larimar Penthouse is a three-bedroom oceanfront suite with a private pool, a separate kitchen and a Personal Insider butler service.
The Chill Pool has a swim-up bar surrounded by lush landscaping.
Scena reimagines traditional Dominican ingredients in an open-kitchen setting.
A selected range of alcoholic drinks, including wines, champagne, beers and cocktails, is included.
A daily calendar includes music experiences, local culture workshops, wellness programs and adventure activities.
Native materials such as Caballero white marble run throughout the property.
The spa has a Himalayan salt sauna, a steam room and hot and cold pools.
Excursions such as mountain buggy rides, cenote dives and private sails can be booked through the resort's Adventure Center.

highlights.text: The Wet Deck infinity pool stretches along the shore.
Some suites have a private pool that is a true swimming space beyond a typical plunge pool.
All guestrooms and suites have ocean or resort views and private balconies, with select swim-up or plunge pool options.
AWAY Spa sits over the ocean with passive and active wet zones, a relaxation area, a beauty salon and a gym studio.
The resort is in Uvero Alto, a more secluded stretch of Punta Cana known for laid-back beaches.

considerations.text: The resort is about a one-hour drive from Punta Cana International Airport.
Spa treatments are not part of the all-inclusive package; hydrotherapy is included with treatments.
WhataHotel notes the vibrant nightlife atmosphere may not suit travelers seeking a quiet, low-key retreat.
